prompt: who won the formula one season in the year nine people were killed on the track at the argentine grand prix, and how old were they two years before sliced bread was first sold?
answer:
The year was **1953**, when the Argentine Grand Prix was marred by a fatal crowd accident. The **1953 Formula One World Championship** was won by **Alberto Ascari**.

Ascari was born on **13 July 1918**. Two years before sliced bread was first sold in July 1928—i.e., in July 1926—he was **7 years old** (turning 8 six days later).
